title: Rama eliminates Dushana and his army
introduction: Rama eliminates fourteen thousand demons led by Duushana. Firstly, the forerunning demons are killed, next Duushana is routed, and then twelve other captains who on knowing Duushana's downfall dashed towards Rama. Left behind are only two, Khara and Trishira, the chiefs of that demonic force in Janasthaana.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे षड् विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 26th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
दूषणः तु स्वकम् सैन्यम् हन्यमानम् विलोक्य च |
संदिदेश महाबाहुः भीम वेगान् निशाचरान्
राक्षसान् पंच साहस्रान् समरेषु अनिवर्तिनः |
verses.iast:
dūṣaṇaḥ tu svakam sainyam hanyamānam vilokya ca |
sandideśa mahābāhuḥ bhīma vegān niśācarān
rākśasān paṃca sāhasrān samareṣu anivartinaḥ |
verses.translation: On seeing the shattering of his own forces, Duushana bid five thousand mighty-armed nightwalkers of monstrous impetus, and who knew no retreat in war, to attack Rama.

glosses.meaning: mighty armed one, Duushana, on his part
his own, forces, on seeing, also

verses.devanagari:
ते शूलैः पट्टिशैः कदगैः शिला वरषैः द्रुमैः
शर वर्षैः विच्छ्हिन्नम् ववर्षुः तम् समन्ततः |
verses.iast:
te śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kadagaiḥ śilā varaṣaiḥ drumaiḥ
śara varṣaiḥ vicchhinnam vavarṣuḥ tam samantataḥ |
verses.translation: And they with spears, scimitars, swords, and with the rains of boulders, trees and arrows rained incessantly and inordinately upon Rama from all over.

verses.devanagari:
तत् द्रुमाणाम् शिलानाम् च वर्षम् प्राण हरम् महत्
प्रतिजग्राह धर्मात्मा राघवः तीक्ष्ण सायकैः |
verses.iast:
tat drumāṇām śilānām ca varṣam prāṇa haram mahat
pratijagrāha dharmātmā rāghavaḥ tīkṣṇa sāyakaiḥ |
verses.translation: Raghava, the virtue-souled, in his turn has neutralised that ghastly and life-taking storm of boulders and trees with his fierce arrows.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिगृह्य च तद् वर्षम् निमीलित इव ऋषभः
रामः क्रोधम् परम् लेभे वध अर्थम् सर्व रक्षसाम् |
verses.iast:
pratigṛhya ca tad varṣam nimīlita iva ṛṣabhaḥ
rāmaḥ krodham param lebhe vadha artham sarva rakṣasām |
verses.translation: Like a bull receiving rain with closed eyes Rama assimilated that storming and then evoked an inordinate infuriation for eliminating all of the demons.

glosses.meaning: with closed eyes, a bull, as with
that, storm, on receiving - on assimilating
of all, demons, elimination, for the sake of

verses.devanagari:
ततः क्रोध समाविष्टः प्रदीप्त इव तेजसा
शरैः अभ्यकिरत् सैन्यम् सर्वतः सह दूषणम् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ krodha samāviṣṭaḥ pradīpta iva tejasā
śaraiḥ abhyakirat sainyam sarvataḥ saha dūṣaṇam |
verses.translation: Exasperation prevailing on him who appeared to be highly blazing with the blaze of his own virtue, he then diffused Duushana and his army with arrows from all over.

glosses.meaning: with blaze [of virtue,] highly blazing, like

verses.devanagari:
ततः सेना पतिः क्रुद्धो दूषणः शत्रु दूषणः
शरैः अशनि कल्पैः तम् राघवम् समवारयत् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ senā patiḥ kruddho dūṣaṇaḥ śatru dūṣaṇaḥ
śaraiḥ aśani kalpaiḥ tam rāghavam samavārayat |
verses.translation: And on becoming enraged Duushana, the railer of his rivals and the commander of that army, then virtually forestalled Raghava's onslaught with his arrows that are simulative of thunderbolts.

verses.devanagari:
ततो रामः संक्रुद्धः क्षुरेण अस्य महत् धनुः
चिच्छ्हेद समरे वीरः चतुर्भिः चतुरो हयान् |
verses.iast:
tato rāmaḥ saṅkruddhaḥ kśureṇa asya mahat dhanuḥ
cicchheda samare vīraḥ caturbhiḥ caturo hayān |
verses.translation: That valiant one in warring Rama is then infuriated and with his crescent-barbed arrow shivered the sturdy bow of Duushana, shredding four of his horses with four more arrows.

glosses.meaning: shivered [bow broken into shivers] / shredded [horses shredded into pieces.]

verses.devanagari:
हत्वा च अश्वान् शरैः तीक्ष्णैः अर्थ चन्द्रेण सारथे
शिरो जहार तद् रक्षः त्रिभिर् विव्याध वक्षसि |
verses.iast:
hatvā ca aśvān śaraiḥ tīkśṇaiḥ artha candreṇa sārathe
śiro jahāra tad rakśaḥ tribhir vivyādha vakśasi |
verses.translation: On destructing the horses with excruciating arrows, he even fragmented the head of the charioteer with a crescent-barbed arrow, and even impaled the chest of demon Duushana with some more arrows.
notes: One crescent dart he aimed which shred / Clean from his neck the driver's head; / Three more with deadly skill addressed / Stood quivering in the giant's breast. - Griffith.

verses.devanagari:
स च्छ्हिन्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः
जग्राह गिरि शृंग आभम् परिघम् रोम हर्षणम् |
वेष्टितम् कांचनैः पट्टैः देव सैन्य अभिमर्दनम्
आयसैः शंकुभिः तीक्ष्णैः कीर्णम् पर वसा उक्षिताम् |
वज्र अशनि सम स्पर्शम् पर गोपुर दारणम्
verses.iast:
sa cchhinna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ
jagrāha giri śṛṃga ābham parigham roma harṣaṇam |
veṣṭitam kāṃcanaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ deva sainya abhimardanam
āyasaiḥ śaṃkubhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ kīrṇam para vasā ukṣitām |
vajra aśani sama sparśam para gopura dāraṇam
verses.translation: With his bow fractured and chariot shredded, and with horses and charioteer killed, he that Duushana grabbed a mace which outranks a peak of mountain and a hair-thriller at its sight, and which girt with golden girths once gritted the armies of gods, the head of which is studded with incisive iron spikes and saturated with the fat of foes, a coequal of a diamond and a thunderbolt in its hardiness and flashiness, and a ransacker of the archways of fortresses of his adversaries.

glosses.meaning: mountain, peak, in its shine - outranking

verses.devanagari:
तम् महा उरग संकाशम् प्रगृह्य परिघम् रणे |
दूषणो अभ्यपतत् रामम् क्रूर कर्मा निशाचरः
verses.iast:
tam mahā uraga saṅkāśam pragṛhya parigham raṇe |
dūṣaṇo abhyapatat rāmam krūra karmā niśācaraḥ
verses.translation: On firmly gripping that mace which in war is akin to an infernal serpent, and the touch of which tantamount to snakebite, rushed that nightwalker Duushana with infernal exerts rushed towards Rama.

glosses.meaning: towards, came, falling] fell upon - rushed at.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य अभिपतमानस्य दूषणस्य स राघवः |
द्वाभ्याम् शराभ्याम् चिच्छ्हेद स हस्त आभरणौ भुजौ
verses.iast:
tasya abhipatamānasya dūṣaṇasya sa rāghavaḥ |
dvābhyām śarābhyām cicchheda sa hasta ābharaṇau bhujau
verses.translation: While Duushana came falling on, he that Raghava sheared off his shoulders that have wrist-ornaments on his arms with two arrows.

glosses.meaning: with, hand, ornaments, shoulders - arms with wrist-ornaments

verses.devanagari:
भ्रष्टः तस्य महाकायः पपात रण मूर्धनि |
परिघः छ्हिन्न हस्तस्य शक्र ध्वज इव अग्रतः
verses.iast:
bhraṣṭaḥ tasya mahākāyaḥ papāta raṇa mūrdhani |
parighaḥ chhinna hastasya śakra dhvaja iva agrataḥ
verses.translation: When Duushana's arms are thus sheared in the van of war, his gigantic mace slipped and spun in his own front, like the flagstaff with flag raised in honour of Indra, and collapsed .

verses.devanagari:
कराभ्याम् च विकीर्णाभ्याम् पपात भुवि दूषणः |
विषाणाभ्याम् विशीर्णाभ्याम् मनस्वी इव महागजः
verses.iast:
karābhyām ca vikīrṇābhyām papāta bhuvi dūṣaṇaḥ |
viṣāṇābhyām viśīr.hṇābhyām manasvī iva mahāgajaḥ
verses.translation: With both of his arms strewn around Duushana fell down onto earth like a haughty and gigantic elephant when both of its tusks are broken down.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा तम् पतितम् भूमौ दूषणम् निहतम् रणे |
साधु साधु इति काकुत्स्थम् सर्व भूतानि अपूजयन्
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā tam patitam bhūmau dūṣaṇam nihatam raṇe |
sādhu sādhu iti kākutstham sarva bhūtāni apūjayan
verses.translation: On seeing Duushana eliminated and fallen to ground, all the beings have applauded Rama saying, 'good, good...'

verses.devanagari:
एतस्मिन् अन्तरे क्रुद्धाः त्रयः सेना अग्र यायिनः |
संहत्य अभ्यद्रवन् रामम् मृत्यु पाश अवपाशिताः
महाकपालः स्थूलाक्षः प्रमाथी च महाबलः |
verses.iast:
etasmin antare kruddhāḥ trayaḥ senā agra yāyinaḥ |
saṃhatya abhyadravan rāmam mṛtyu pāśa avapāśitāḥ
mahākapālaḥ sthūlākṣaḥ pramāthī ca mahābalaḥ |
verses.translation: In the meantime infuriated are the three leading commanders of that army, namely Mahakapaala, Sthulaaksha and great mighty Pramaathii, and they collectively ran towards Rama, bound by the rein of death.

verses.devanagari:
महाकपालो विपुलम् शूलम् उद्यम्य राक्षसः
स्थूलाक्षः पट्टिशम् गृह्य प्रमाथी च परश्वधम् |
verses.iast:
mahākapālo vipulam śūlam udyamya rākṣasaḥ
sthūlākṣaḥ paṭṭiśam gṛhya pramāthī ca paraśvadham |
verses.translation: Mahakapaala raising a broad trident, Sthulaaksha handling a scimitar, Pramaathi handling an axe rushed towards Rama.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वा एव आपततः ताम् तु राघवः सायकैः शितैः
तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः प्रतिजग्राह संप्राप्तान् अतिथीन् इव |
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvā eva āpatataḥ tām tu rāghavaḥ sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ
tīkṣṇa agraiḥ pratijagrāha samprāptān atithīn iva |
verses.translation: As one would receive guests meeting his basic needs, Raghava too took on these untimely guests of war, rather the insurgents, meeting their basic needs which now are no more than highly sharpened acute edged arrows, when he saw them coming and falling upon him, inopportunely.

glosses.meaning: sharpened, with acute, edges, with arrows
chanced, [guests] without, time limit [an inopportune guests of war] as with

verses.devanagari:
महाकपालस्य शिरः चिच्छ्हेद रघुनंदनः
असंख्येयैः तु बाण ओघैः प्रममाथ प्रमाथिनम् |
स्थूलाक्षस्य अक्षिणी स्थूले पूरयामास सायकैः
स पपात हतो भूमौ विटपी इव महाद्रुमः |
दूषणस्य अनुगान् पंच सहस्रान् कुपितः क्षणात्
हत्वा तु पंच सहस्रान् अनयत् यम सदनम् |
verses.iast:
mahākapālasya śiraḥ cicchheda raghunaṃdanaḥ
asaṅkhyeyaiḥ tu bāṇa oghaiḥ pramamātha pramāthinam |
sthūlākṣasya akṣiṇī sthūle pūrayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ
sa papāta hato bhūmau viṭapī iva mahādrumaḥ |
dūṣaṇasya anugān paṃca sahasrān kupitaḥ kśaṇāt
hatvā tu paṃca sahasrān anayat yama sadanam |
verses.translation: Rama, the legatee of Raghu, chopped off the head of Mahakapaala, with incalculable spates of arrows he eliminated Pramaathi, and filled the bulging eyes of Sthulaaksha with arrows by which Sthulaaksha is killed and fell down onto ground like a burly tree with its broad branches. Then still infuriated Rama forthwith eliminated the five thousand hench-demons of Duushana with five thousand arrows, and thus he led them to the residence of Time-god, namely the hell.
notes: The words viṭapi 'a tree with branches and twigs...' and druma 'a tree' in general. Though they are similar to give the general meaning of a tree, they are juxtaposed taking the viṭapi as the adjective of the word druma. This is not exactly synonymic usage, but a shade of difference is available in both words. Readers may please refer to the excellent book of Dr. Satya Vrat, The Ramayana - A Linguistic Study.

glosses.meaning: not, calculable, but, arrows, with spate of
led them, to Yam, Time-god's, residence [hell.]

verses.devanagari:
दूषणम् निहतम् श्रुत्वा तस्य च एव पदानुगान्
व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धो सेन अध्यक्षान् महाबलान् |
verses.iast:
dūṣaṇam nihatam śrutvā tasya ca eva padānugān
vyādideśa kharaḥ kruddho sena adhyakśān mahābalān |
verses.translation: On hearing about the killing of Duushana and also thus of the followers of Duushana, Khara irately ordered his army captains, under whose captaincy mighty forces are there.

glosses.meaning: to them who have mighty forces under them, to army, captains

verses.devanagari:
अयम् विनिहतः संख्ये दूषणः स पदानुगाः
महत्या सेनया सार्धम् युद्ध्वा रामम् कुमानुषम् |
शस्त्रैः नाना विध अकारैः हनध्वम् सर्व राक्षसाः
verses.iast:
ayam vinihataḥ saṃkhye dūṣaṇaḥ sa padānugāḥ
mahatyā senayā sārdham yuddhvā rāmam kumānuṣam |
śastraiḥ nānā vidha akāraiḥ hanadhvam sarva rākśasāḥ
verses.translation: "Duushana is killed in war along with his followers, hence all you demons, take formidable army, take weapons of diverse designs, combat and kill that evil-human Rama..." Thus Khara ordered the remaining demons.

glosses.meaning: diverse, kinds of, having designs, with weapons

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्त्वा खरः क्रुद्धो रामम् एव अभि दुद्रुवे |
श्येनगामी पृथुग्रीवो यज्ञशत्रुर् विहंगमः
दुर्जयः करवीराक्षः परुषः कालकार्मुकः |
हेममाली महामाली सर्पस्यो रुधिराशनः
द्वादश एते महावीर्या बल अध्यक्षाः स सैनिकाः
रमम् एव अभ्यधावंत विसृजंतः शरोत्तमान्
verses.iast:
evam uk{}tvā kharaḥ kruddho rāmam eva abhi dudruve |
śyenagāmī pṛthugrīvo yajñaśatrur vihaṃgamaḥ
durjayaḥ karavīrākśaḥ paruṣaḥ kālakārmukaḥ |
hemamālī mahāmālī sarpasyo rudhirāśanaḥ
dvādaśa ete mahāvīryā bala adhyakśāḥ sa sainikāḥ
ramam eva abhyadhāvaṃta visṛjaṃtaḥ śarottamān
verses.translation: Saying so Khara himself rushed towards Rama in rage, and Shyenagaami, Prithugriiva, Yajnashatru, Vihangama Durjaya, Karaviiraaksha, Parusha, Kaalakaarmuka, Hemamaali, Mahaamaali, Sarpaasya, and Rudhiraaksha are the twelve fiendishly atrocious troop leaders of demonic forces, and they too rushed towards Rama launching their atrocious arrows.

glosses.meaning: Shyenagaami, Prithugriiva, Yajnashatru, Vihangama durjayaH karaviiraakshaH paruSaH kaalakaarmukaH = Durjaya, Karaviiraaksha, Parusha, Kaalakaarmuka
arrows, best ones - atrocious one, while launching

verses.devanagari:
ततः पावक संकाशैः हेम वज्र विभूषितैः |
जघन शेषम् तेजस्वी तस्य सैन्यस्य सायकैः
verses.iast:
tataḥ pāvaka saṅkāśaiḥ hema vajra vibhūṣitaiḥ |
jaghana śeṣam tejasvī tasya sainyasya sāyakaiḥ
verses.translation: He who is resplendent that Rama then annihilated the remaining demons of that army with his arrows that are embellished with gold and diamonds, and that are blazing like ritual-fires.

verses.devanagari:
ते रुक्म पुंखा विशिखाः स धूमा इव पावकाः |
निजघ्नुः तानि रक्षांसि वज्रा इव महाद्रुमान्
verses.iast:
te rukma puṃkhā viśikhāḥ sa dhūmā iva pāvakāḥ |
nijaghnuḥ tāni rakṣāṃsi vajrā iva mahādrumān
verses.translation: With those arrows that have golden tailpieces and sharp barbs, and that are dazzling like fuming ritual fires Rama felled the demons, as Thunderbolts of Indra will be felling gigantic trees.

glosses.meaning: with, fumes, similar to, [dazzling] ritual-fires, as though

verses.devanagari:
रक्षसाम् तु शतम् रामः शतेन एकेन कर्णिना |
सहस्रम् तु सहस्रेण जघान रण मूर्धनि
verses.iast:
rakṣasām tu śatam rāmaḥ śatena ekena karṇinā |
sahasram tu sahasreṇa jaghāna raṇa mūrdhani
verses.translation: With a hundred rudder like arrows Rama hit down a hundred demons, and with a thousand more, thousand more demons are hit in the forefront of that war.

glosses.meaning: with rudder-like [helm/tiller of a rudder of a ship,] suchlike arrow

verses.devanagari:
तैः भिन्न वर्म आभरणाः छ्हिन्न भिन्न शर आसनाः |
निपेतुः शोणित आदिग्धा धरण्याम् रजनीचराः
verses.iast:
taiḥ bhinna varma ābharaṇāḥ chhinna bhinna śara āsanāḥ |
nipetuḥ śoṇita ādigdhā dharaṇyām rajanīcarāḥ
verses.translation: Ripped are their shields and armorial-ornaments, ruined and rickety are their bows, and they the nightwalkers fell flat on ground, bodies wholly smudged with blood.

verses.devanagari:
तैः मुक्त केशैः समरे पतितैः शोणित उक्षितैः |
विस्तीर्णा वसुधा कृत्स्ना महावेदिः कुशैः इव
verses.iast:
taiḥ muk{}ta keśaiḥ samare patitaiḥ śoṇita ukṣitaiḥ |
vistīrṇā vasudhā kṛt.hsnā mahāvediḥ kuśaiḥ iva
verses.translation: With those demons that have fallen down in war, whose hair is tousled and who are drenched in blood, entire earth looked like a vast altar of fire overspread with holy grass.

glosses.meaning: vast, fire-altar, with holy-grass, spread over with, like [became.]

verses.devanagari:
तत् क्षणे तु महा घोरम् वनम् निहत राक्षसम् |
बभूव निरय प्रख्यम् मांस शोणित कर्दमम्
verses.iast:
tat kṣaṇe tu mahā ghoram vanam nihata rākṣasam |
babhūva niraya prakhyam māṃsa śoṇita kardamam
verses.translation: That forest which became sludgy with the flesh and blood of killed demons and very disgusting, in a moment it became identical with hell.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् |
हतानि एकेन रामेण मानुषेण पदातिना
verses.iast:
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām |
hatāni ekena rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇa padātinā
verses.translation: Thus that Rama, a lone one, that too a foot-soldier, has eliminated fourteen thousand demons of frightening exploits.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य सैन्यस्य सर्वस्य खरः शेषो महारथः |
राक्षसः त्रिशिराः चैव रामः च रिपुसूदनः
verses.iast:
tasya sainyasya sarvasya kharaḥ śeṣo mahārathaḥ |
rākṣasaḥ triśirāḥ caiva rāmaḥ ca ripusūdanaḥ
verses.translation: Of his entire army great-charioteer Khara and Trishira are the remaining nightwalkers, and Rama, the enemy destroyer, naturally on the other side.
notes: The last compound in the second foot indicates that Rama is also remaining as one among the army of Khara, which is found irksome to some scholars. They said that the older mms contain the expression hata śeṣau niśāacarā instead of rāmaḥ ca ripu sūdanaḥ taking the finishing line from the opening words of next verse. Otherwise, it can be said 'on the side of Khara only two demons, namely Khara and Trishira are remaining, and on the other side Rama is remaining...' as given here. But it is said to be inappropriate, because Rama cannot be grouped with the killable side. Further, there are some more petty demons besides Khara and Trishira, to carry a word to Ravana, as said in the coming chapters.

verses.devanagari:
शेषा हता महावीर्या राक्षसा रण मूर्धनि |
घोरा दुर्विषहाः सर्वे लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रजेन
verses.iast:
śeṣā hatā mahāvīryā rākśasā raṇa mūrdhani |
ghorā durviṣahāḥ sarve lakśmaṇasya agrajena
verses.translation: Lakshmana's elder brother Rama eliminated all of the remaining demons in the forefront of war who are highly valorous, ghastly and unbearable.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तु तद् भीम बलम् महा आहवे
समीक्ष्य रामेण हतम् बलीयसा |
रथेन रामम् महता खरः ततः
समाससाद इन्द्र इव उद्यत अशनिः
verses.iast:
tataḥ tu tad bhīma balam mahā āhave
samīkṣya rāmeṇa hatam balīyasā |
rathena rāmam mahatā kharaḥ tataḥ
samāsasāda indra iva udyata aśaniḥ
verses.translation: Then on surveying that great demonic force which is eliminated by Rama in that staggering war, Khara then marched on to reach Rama in a huge chariot, as with Indra who will march upraising his Thunderbolt.
